# widgetlib

A small library for rendering widgets.

## Review rule

A change is approved ONLY when ALL of these hold:
1. The latest CI run is green (see `ci/last_run.log`).
2. The version in `pyproject.toml` was bumped for the change.
3. The change is recorded in `CHANGELOG.md` under the new version.

If any one fails, the change needs more work.
src/widget.py:
def render(widget):
    # Change under review: added a border option.
    border = widget.get('border', False)
    body = widget['body']
    if border:
        return '[' + body + ']'
    return body
